subject: reasoning
question: Six friends Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. S sits third to the right of V. V sits second to the left of Q. U sits to the immediate left of R. Who sits to the immediate right of S?
solution:
Given: Six friends Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

 
• S sits third to the right of V.
 
• V sits second to the left of Q.
 
• U sits to the immediate left of R

The Final Arrangement 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e49ae8bafc10f99e0fa2beb6c2fee66be6bbced8ba5d4b280d2c69cd6c8655b1.png] 

U sits immediate right of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
